full_judgment: 3. The trial court allowed pre-emption but the lower appellate court dismissed it on the findings that the application was barred by limitation; and the land transferred under the kabala being non-agricultural land the application under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 was not maintainable. Against the order of the lower appellate court the petitioners moved the High Court Division in revision under section 115 of the Code but it was summarily rejected. Against the order of rejection the petitioners moved an application for review, upon which Rule was issued upon the opposite parties, but after hearing the parties the Rule was discharged. Against this order the petitioners seek leave to appeal.
